name: Ariane
title: Ember Astronomer
summary: A young court astronomer rebuilding the lost calendar after the northern firefall.
quote: Every scorched map is only a sky chart that no one has read correctly yet.

connections.label: Active Region
connections.value: Northern marches of the First Empire

body: Ariane began as a copyist apprentice in the lower archive, then rose after proving she could read faded star charts on burned parchment.
While cataloging the debris that arrived after the firefall of New Calendar 27, she reconstructed an abandoned military road leading toward the lost frontier.

name: Soren
title: Captain of the Trailan Forest Riders
summary: A border cavalry commander who knows the hidden roads around Stag Pass and the northern tribes.
quote: The forest never lies. Only people hide the truth on maps.
body: Soren comes from a family that has guarded Stag Pass for generations and remembers every woodland trail and watershed by oral tradition.
During negotiations with the northern tribes, he also tracks signs that imperial loyalists are rebuilding influence along the border.

name: Vesra
title: Bell Archive Keeper
faction: Council of the Bell Tower City
summary: Keeper of ceasefire records and religious judgments, with access to the hidden files of the Seven Seats.
quote: History gains weight not from who writes it, but from who is allowed to lock it away.
body: Vesra preserves every copy of the accords signed after the Black Bell armistice and therefore knows the real limits of several rival factions.
She exchanges secret letters with Ariane, trading clues between the northern firefall and the fractured crown documents.
